source.repository: external: curl/curl (https://github.com/curl/curl), cloned locally for this review

groundTruth.description: Fixes CVE-2023-38545, a widely-publicized heap buffer overflow in curl's SOCKS5 proxy handshake (lib/socks.c). First C/systems-programming case in the corpus (prior cases are all memory-safe languages). do_SOCKS5() is a state machine re-entered across multiple calls/connection reuses; the >255-byte hostname check that was supposed to force a fallback to local DNS resolution ran only in the CONNECT_SOCKS_INIT state, but the state machine can reach the remote-resolve code path (CONNECT_RESOLVE_REMOTE, which memcpy()s the raw hostname into a fixed connection buffer using a 1-byte length field) without re-running that check on every pass - notably on an HTTPS-proxy redirect to a new, longer hostname after the connection has already progressed past CONNECT_SOCKS_INIT. The fix makes the overlong-hostname case a hard error (CURLPX_LONG_HOSTNAME) instead of a same-pass variable flip, and fixes an unrelated signed/unsigned mismatch in the length-byte cast. The reviewed diff is a 6-line change to one function in one file; the exploitability depends on surrounding state-machine structure not itself touched by the diff, which this ground truth states from direct reading of the pre-fix code, not from running a working exploit (no C build toolchain was used to compile and reproduce this in a sandboxed manner).

evidence.note: overlong-hostname detection changed from a silent same-pass fallback to a hard CURLPX_LONG_HOSTNAME error
length-byte cast changed from signed char to unsigned char

runs.label: live run, Claude Code CLI 2.1.299, external repository input, maxInputTokensPerReviewer 150000, context-window 250000
runs.outcomeNote: All three reviewers completed with zero findings against this 6-line single-file diff. Consistent with the other small, well-targeted known-fix cases in this corpus (005, 010), though notably not with case 013/015, where a similarly small-looking diff turned out to hide a real additional bug - a reminder that a clean result here doesn't generalize to 'small diffs are always clean,' only to this specific one.

notes: The real commit also added tests/data/test728 and a Makefile.inc entry; excluded from the reviewed diff as test-only additions, consistent with how other cases in this corpus scope test files out.
